title: 第534章 下饵第533章 古往今来最实用的权谋
lines: 老祖很忙。
白小飞也很忙。
忙，忙点好啊。
老祖在忙着到处找残破小秘境，白小飞则是在忙着到处散播基因种子。
近百万年时间，足够这些基因种子全部扩散开并发展起来，武道将彻底进入多体质争锋时代。
老祖相信一定能碰撞出不同的火花。
真是对不起众生了，老祖灵活的道德底线又飘向邪恶阵营。
唤醒真善美暂时放一放，武道争锋时代到来。
系统撒下因果线，老祖高坐钓鱼台。
末法时代到来，仙道派人出来的同时，整个世界开始沸腾。
争端开始了，世界各地都有青年才俊层出不穷，他们之间会因利相对，会有意气之争，会有地盘相争。
神意境往上的是上修，下面的通通都是下修。
上修少争端，下修人脑打成狗脑。
老祖在用张神意的功法影响所有人，他要认为创造一个武道大争之世。
佛门还在，但苦佛自然察觉出这是帝释天手笔，因此他也只能无奈维持住凡人不会被大面积波及的局面，其余的他是真管不了。
能量耗费巨大，仅老祖一个人肯定顶不住，于是老祖把白小飞也拉过来充当充电宝，二人一起才勉强维持住消耗。
就这，偶尔还得超标，老祖只好再耗费些不灭物质来弥补。
时间一点点流逝，九种体质彻底融入整个武道之中，各地不断有天才杀出偌大的名号。
质量方面就不可同日而语。
原本最难的第一关天人境，天人武者如同雨后春笋不断冒出。
下面的战况太激烈了，不是皇朝争霸就是门派之争，底层武者们一生大大小小激烈交锋过无数次，他们在忍痛和意志能力方面是几层楼几层楼的往上蹦。
这种养蛊方式，老祖其实早就考虑过了，只不过考虑到自己也没有那么急，所以一直没付出行动，转而想唤醒人们的真善美。
现在情况不一样了，老祖的灵活道德底线只好左右飘摇。
除了这个之外，老子的分身们还在外面不断收集秘境。
这是为了打造环境所用。
如果可以，老祖还是想将最终地点设置在小世界里，以免波及现世导致造成无法挽回的后果。
小心在变强，她已经把所有能力升级到最后关卡。
百多万年匆匆而过，仙道盛世再次降临。
随着大道显现，这种最好的时机，小心赶紧闭关抓紧时间突破。
她的力量也是蹭蹭蹭的上涨。
等到大道显化结束，她又闭关几百年消化所悟，直到进度开始放缓以后才短暂出关。
“怎么样，重瞳合一是什么效果？”老祖急切询问。
它或许无法成为关键扭转局势的技能，但它也是小心必不可少的。
小心直接将系统面板展示给老祖。
序列特殊能力解锁——重瞳合一：生死轮转
（提示：阴阳瞳力交融，生死大道构建。左眼所破之妄，右眼可重塑其真，左眼所伤之敌，右眼可夺其生机以哺自身。
左眼破掉对手法术，右眼瞬间解析其能量构成并‘复刻’为己用，或左眼造成不可愈的伤势，右眼转瞬以造化之力反哺自身，形成“以战养战”的永动循环。）
老祖有点失望。

Ancestor is very busy.
Bai Xiaofei is also very busy.
Busy, it’s better to be busy.
The ancestor was busy looking for broken little secrets everywhere, while Bai Xiaofei was busy spreading gene seeds everywhere.
Nearly a million years will be enough for all these gene seeds to spread and develop, and martial arts will completely enter the era of multi-physique competition.
Ancestor believes that different sparks will definitely come out of collision.
I'm really sorry for all sentient beings. The ancestor's flexible moral bottom line has drifted towards the evil camp again.
Awakening the truth, goodness and beauty, let it go for a while, and the era of martial arts competition has arrived.
The system casts a line of cause and effect, and the ancestor sits high on the Diaoyutai.
The end of the Dharma era has arrived, and at the same time that Immortal Dao sent people out, the whole world began to boil.
Disputes have begun. There are young talents emerging from all over the world. They will compete with each other for their own interests, will have conflicts of temperament, and will compete for territory.
What goes up in the spiritual realm is upward cultivation, and everything below is downward cultivation.
There will be less disputes among the higher cultivators, while the lower cultivators will beat the human brains into dog brains.
The ancestor is using Zhang Shenyi's skills to influence everyone. He wants to create a world of great martial arts competition.
Buddhism is still there, but Ku Buddha naturally realized that this was the handiwork of Emperor Shakti, so he could only helplessly maintain a situation where mortals would not be affected on a large scale. He really couldn't control the rest.
The energy consumption was huge, and the Ancestor alone would definitely not be able to withstand it, so the Ancestor brought Bai Xiaofei over to act as a power bank, and the two of them together could barely maintain the consumption.
In this way, it occasionally exceeds the standard, and the ancestor has to spend more immortal materials to make up for it.
As time passes, the nine constitutions are completely integrated into the entire martial arts, and geniuses from all over the world continue to make great names.
In terms of quality, the same cannot be said.
Originally the most difficult first level, the Heavenly Realm, Heavenly Warriors kept popping up like mushrooms after a rain.
The battles below were too fierce. It was either a dynasty battle for hegemony or a sect battle. The warriors at the bottom had fought fiercely countless times in their lives, and their pain tolerance and willpower were soaring up several floors.
The ancestor had actually considered this method of raising gu a long time ago, but considering that he was not in a hurry, he never took any action, and instead wanted to awaken people's truth, goodness and beauty.
The situation is different now, and the ancestor's flexible moral bottom line has to waver left and right.
In addition to this, Lao Tzu's clones are still collecting secret realms outside.
This is for creating an environment.
If possible, the ancestor would still like to set the final location in the small world to prevent it from affecting the current world and causing irreparable consequences.
Be careful and get stronger, she has upgraded all her abilities to the final level.
More than a million years passed by in a hurry, and the prosperous age of immortality came again.
As the great road appears, this is the best opportunity, so be careful and retreat quickly to seize the time to break through.
Her strength also increased slowly.
When the manifestation of the Great Dao was over, she went into seclusion for hundreds of years to digest what she had learned. It was not until her progress began to slow down that she briefly came out of seclusion.
"How is it? What is the effect of combining double pupils into one?" the ancestor asked eagerly.
It may not be a critical situation-turning skill, but it is also essential to be careful.
Be careful to show the system panel directly to the ancestor.
Sequential special abilities unlocked - double pupils in one: the cycle of life and death
(Tip: The power of yin and yang pupil merges to build the road of life and death. The right eye can reconstruct the truth of the illusion destroyed by the left eye. The right eye can take away the vitality of the enemy injured by the left eye to feed itself.
The left eye destroys the opponent's spell, and the right eye instantly analyzes its energy composition and 'reproduces' it for one's own use. Or the left eye causes irreparable injuries, and the right eye instantly feeds itself back with the power of creation, forming a perpetual cycle of "fighting to feed war." )
This...
The ancestor was a little disappointed.
